root_review: root实际分六段逐词读600个现存en、中文义、完整词典及1200组完整双语，再逐项读三个冻结作者稿的103项建议。保留正确另一基本义和原空，不强制覆盖全部多义。root仅微调purify去浓度限定、新增exhibitor避免组织者混淆。作者及整批审读全部冻结后apply。

root_sources_checked.supports: 净化是去除杂质，不要求蒸馏或增加浓度。
参展者是展示自己产品或作品的人/公司，不要求组织展会。
5.2.1逼和要求无合法走法且王未被将军，root实际读取。
10.6.1击倒后规定计数内未恢复比赛为KO，不要求昏迷，root实际读取。
乳糜泻为麸质诱发免疫反应损伤小肠，只作术语辨识。
消化把食物分解为可吸收物质，只作术语辨识。

root_adjustments.author_after: to remove unwanted substances from something and make it cleaner or more concentrated
root_adjustments.final_after: to remove impurities or unwanted substances from something
root_adjustments.reason: 纯净不等同浓度变高，删除非必要浓度结果。

root_adjustments.author_after: someone who organizes an exhibit for others to see
root_adjustments.final_after: a person or company displaying goods or work at an exhibition
root_adjustments.reason: 明确参展展示者，避免组织展览者/展会主办者混淆。

boundaries: 仅en字段；学习ID、词头、中文、音标、原完整词典及全部例句保持。
Tod普通姓名不锁定某个人或羊毛重量旧义，清空回退既有中文题。
458正确基本义和38原空保留，不为列全多义重写。
覆盖不是全库专业语言审校，未做真人听审。

changes.before: proceeding from natural feeling or impulse without external stimulus
changes.after: acting on a sudden urge without considering the consequences
changes.reason: 旧英文添加without external stimulus，冲动购买仍可能受外部刺激；两句核心为未充分考虑就行动，移除错误必要条件。

changes.before: The world; a globe as an ensign of royalty.
changes.after: a French word used for fashionable society or a social circle
changes.reason: 旧释取世界与王权球体；中文和两句beau monde指社交界，Merriam-Webster确认时髦社交界义。

changes.before: v bestow honor or rewards upon
changes.after: feeling privileged, or treated with special respect
changes.reason: 词头和两句均表示感到荣幸或备受尊敬；旧主动动词bestow写成授予别人荣誉，改为现状态义。

changes.before: the point on the celestial sphere toward which the sun and solar system appear to be moving relative to the fixed stars
changes.after: the highest point or top of something
changes.reason: 旧英文取太阳系运动方向的天球顶点；屋顶与事业最高点均不对应该天文限定，改为顶点基本义。

changes.before: a confident assertive person who acts as instigator

changes.before: drawing position in chess: any of a player's possible moves would place his king in check
changes.after: a deadlock, or a chess draw when the player to move has no legal move but is not in check
changes.reason: 旧国际象棋释义遗漏王未被将军的关键条件，可混同将死；FIDE 5.2.1明确此条件，保留僵局常用义。

changes.before: Yea.
changes.after: an informal spelling of you, or an abbreviation for young adult in publishing
changes.reason: 旧英文Yea为肯定应答；See ya和YA fiction分别是you口语拼写与young adult，Cambridge确认这两义。

changes.before: quick to understand
changes.after: worried that something unpleasant may happen
changes.reason: 旧英文为敏悟、很快理解的旧义，与中文忧虑及面试、飞机起动两句不匹配；Collins确认担忧义。

changes.before: remove impurities from, increase the concentration of, and separate through the process of distillation
changes.after: to remove impurities or unwanted substances from something
changes.reason: 旧英文把净化限定为蒸馏；第一句明确过滤器净水，不必蒸馏，Collins支持移除杂质的一般义。

changes.before: n a unit of luminous flux equal to the amount of light given out through a solid angle of 1 steradian by a point source of 1 candela intensity radiating uniformly in all directions
changes.after: an abbreviation for learning management system, software for organizing courses and assignments
changes.reason: 旧英文是流明单位，错配学习管理系统缩写；Moodle官方对课程、教学活动与资料管理的描述支持软件系统义。

changes.before: n a police officer who investigates crimes
changes.after: an informal shortened word for a detective
changes.reason: 旧英文要求是警察，第二句明确private tec，私家侦探不必是警察；Merriam-Webster确认侦探俚语，不限受雇单位。

changes.before: someone who organizes an exhibit for others to see
changes.after: a person or company displaying goods or work at an exhibition
changes.reason: root交叉审读发现organizes易混成展会组织者；Cambridge出版社明确展示自己产品或作品的参展人/公司，不要求是展览组织者。

changes.before: in a manner acceptable to common custom
changes.after: in a lawful way, or with a valid reason or justification
changes.reason: 旧英文只说符合习俗；合法取得土地与有理由不满不以地方习俗为判据，改为合法或有正当根据的义。

changes.before: happening at the same time
changes.after: by chance, without being planned or expected
changes.reason: 旧英文只是同时发生，未说明巧合；同航班和同生日两句重在偶然，Cambridge确认chance or luck义。

changes.before: Alt. of Crayer
changes.after: an informal Australian and New Zealand word for a crayfish
changes.reason: 旧英文仅转向Crayer旧形式，无法解释中文螯虾或姓氏；Collins确认澳新螯虾口语义，不猜两句普通姓氏具体是谁。

changes.before: a member of a people with dark skin and hair who speak Romany and who traditionally live by seasonal work and fortunetelling; they are believed to have originated in northern India but now are living on all continents (but mostly in Europe, North Africa, and North America)

changes.before: a barb on a harpoon or arrow
changes.after: a lucky result or success that happens by chance
changes.reason: 旧英文是鱼叉或箭头倒刺，与中文侥幸、两句获胜及满分不匹配，改为偶然成功义。

changes.before: s proceeding to a conclusion by reason or argument rather than intuition
changes.after: moving from one subject to another without staying focused
changes.reason: 旧英文是通过推理得出结论的哲学义；中文和两句均为离题、东拉西扯，改为相应用法。

changes.before: n a radioactive transuranic element synthesized from californium
changes.after: an abbreviation for long range, describing an extended operating distance
changes.reason: 旧英文取化学元素铹符号；中文和两句明确远程型号与long range缩写，NAVAIR官方确认LR/LE为Long Range/Long Endurance。

changes.before: a sweeping stroke or blow
changes.after: to slide a finger or card across a surface, or to steal something casually
changes.reason: 旧英文为强打或挥击名词；现常用中文和两句是屏幕滑动及顺走笔，改为这些动词基本义。

changes.before: n (genetics) genetic variation in a DNA sequence that occurs when a single nucleotide in a genome is altered; SNPs are usually considered to be point mutations that have been evolutionarily successful enough to recur in a significant proportion of the population of a species

changes.reason: 旧英文是DNA单核苷酸变异；本站中文与两句明确苏格兰民族党，党官网支持政治组织及独立诉求性质。

changes.before: an eastern subfamily of Malayo-Polynesian languages
changes.after: relating to the ocean or life in it
changes.reason: 旧英文取马来波利尼西亚语族分支；中文和洋流、海洋生物两句都是海洋形容词。

changes.before: warding off

changes.before: United States singer and film actress (1922-1969)

changes.before: able to absorb fluids

changes.before: sexual allure

changes.before: (chemistry) not participating in a chemical reaction; chemically inert

changes.before: a small adhesive disk of paste; used to seal letters

changes.before: part of a compound leaf

changes.reason: 旧哲学多元论义与多元文化社群语境错配。

changes.after: to write something down quickly; a very small amount

changes.before: a linguistic element added to a word to produce an inflected or derived form
changes.after: to attach or add something to something else
changes.reason: 旧释只为词缀名词；贴标签和签名两句均使用附加的动词。

changes.before: assets that are saleable though not material or physical
changes.after: not physical or touchable; difficult to define precisely
changes.reason: 旧释限定为可出售的无形资产；信任及房间的温馨气氛为无形、难以量化的性质，不要求可出售。

changes.before: s rounded like an egg
changes.after: shaped like an ellipse; expressed with words left out or meaning implied
changes.reason: 旧释把椭圆笼统说成蛋形；改为几何椭圆，并与第二句省略、含蓄的回答分别表达。

changes.before: challenge the honesty or veracity of
changes.after: to formally accuse a public official of misconduct in office
changes.reason: 旧释为质疑诚实；两句都讨论总统遭正式弹劾，改为提出职务不当指控，不等同已经免职。

changes.before: s not to be placated or appeased or moved by entreaty
changes.after: continuing without weakening or becoming less intense
changes.reason: 旧释只指不会被恳求安抚的人；持续的雨和压力应是不减弱、不停歇。

changes.before: n a legally binding command or decision entered on the court record (as if issued by a court or judge)
changes.after: an order or decision made by someone with authority
changes.reason: 旧释把命令限定为法院登记的有法律约束力决定；official fiat是权威命令，不必出自法院。保留正确基础命令义，不强加汽车品牌义。

changes.before: a piece of armor plate (with eye slits) fixed or hinged to a medieval helmet to protect the face
changes.after: a part of a helmet or cap that protects or shades the face; a sunshade in a vehicle
changes.reason: 旧释把面罩限为有眼缝的中世纪金属甲片；两句现代头盔和汽车遮阳板不具有这些限定。

changes.before: use a surgical instrument to hold open (the edges of a wound or an organ)
changes.after: to take back a statement; to pull something back or inward
changes.reason: 旧释实际是牵开器器械，而不是目标动词；两句为撤回陈述及收起轮子。

changes.before: small flat ring-shaped cake or cookie
changes.after: a confused mixture of things; to mix things together without order
changes.reason: 旧释为环形小饼干；抽屉里的混乱和混放衣物两句为杂乱混合。

changes.before: deliberately causing harm or damage
changes.after: playfully naughty or likely to cause trouble
changes.reason: 旧释要求故意造成损害；孩子的笑与打开橱柜的猫表示调皮，不必有恶意伤害。

changes.before: a small drink of liquor
changes.after: a quick small bite or pinch; a slight sharp feeling of cold
changes.reason: 旧释只指一小口酒；两句是空气的寒意及轻咬。

changes.before: inject into the vein
changes.after: relating to a principal railway route
changes.reason: 旧释是静脉注射毒品；两句明确干线列车和铁路，没有注射语境。

changes.before: n a person who conveys (carries or transmits)
changes.after: a machine, often using a moving belt, that carries goods or materials
changes.reason: 旧释限定搬运的人；箱子和粮食沿机械输送机移动，两句均为设备。

changes.before: n the cardinal number that is the sum of one and one and one
changes.after: a group of three; a musical chord made of three notes
changes.reason: 旧释解释基数三而非三者组成的组；两句为三因素组合及三和弦。

changes.before: (taxes) an amount that can be deducted (especially for the purposes of calculating income tax)
changes.after: able to be subtracted from a total; an amount paid by an insured person before insurance covers a claim
changes.reason: 旧释把词当作税务可扣除金额；首句是可扣除的形容词，第二句是保险免赔额，分别表示。

changes.before: kill one in every ten, as of mutineers in Roman armies
changes.after: to destroy a large part of something or greatly reduce its numbers
changes.reason: 旧释局限古罗马每十人杀一人；鸟群数量锐减与工厂遭重创使用现代大量毁坏义。

changes.before: n slang for a paunch
changes.after: an informal word for the stomach or belly
changes.reason: 旧释把肚子限定为大肚腩；孩子肚痛和狗腹部两句没有肥胖信息。

changes.before: the process of decomposing organic matter (as in sewage) by bacteria or by chemical action or heat
changes.after: the process of breaking down food into substances the body can absorb
changes.reason: 旧释是污水有机物分解等技术过程；课文及医生问诊语境都是身体的食物消化。

changes.before: state of violent mental agitation
changes.after: a strong, often short-lived enthusiasm for something
changes.reason: 旧释是暴烈的精神激动；面包及玩具的风潮指一时流行的热衷。

changes.before: hidden from general view or use
changes.after: knowing private or secret information; an outdoor toilet
changes.reason: 旧释只说隐蔽的；privy to表示知晓内幕，而第二句是室外厕所，分别表示对应常用义。

changes.before: game equipment consisting of an open ring of iron used in playing horseshoes
changes.after: a U-shaped metal shoe fitted to a horse’s hoof; something shaped like it
changes.reason: 旧释仅指投掷游戏用具；铁匠马蹄及桌子排列两句指马蹄铁和马蹄形。

changes.before: a gift of public land or resources for the private gain of a limited group
changes.after: a free gift or an event offering free items; a clue that unintentionally reveals something
changes.reason: 旧释只指把公共土地资源赠送给少数人；两句为暴露事实的线索和店铺赠品活动，不要求涉及公共资产。

changes.before: a resentment strong enough to justify retaliation
changes.after: a lasting feeling of resentment; to be unwilling to give or allow something
changes.reason: 旧释无根据地把怨恨说成足以正当化报复；移除报复正当性限定，保留积怨及不愿给予的通常义。

changes.before: an act that brings discredit to the person who does it
changes.after: a spot or stain, especially of ink; to absorb liquid with cloth or paper
changes.reason: 旧释只说给人带来耻辱的行为；两句是墨渍和吸干洒出的液体。
